I knock on Otoha’s door and wait for her to answer.
scene black
But I get tired of waiting after approximately half a second and decide to just let myself in since it’s probably the only chance I’ll ever get to see her without her clothes on.
scene otohasreallyhotdude1
Damn. She isn’t naked.
: Um...hi?
: Hey.
: Can I...help you?
: Yes, actually. If I go back outside, can you get undressed really quickly so I can walk in on you changing?
: Sure.
: Yeah, I didn’t think s- what?
: Go for it. I’ll give you thirty seconds.
scene black
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, that’s enough.
scene otohasreallyhotdude1
: Thank you for-
: You really thought I was gonna do it, huh?
: Rin would have done it. In fact, I wouldn’t have even had to ask her.
: I think that would just literally be walking in on someone while they’re getting changed.
: That’s correct. But she’d get over it in like five seconds and I know this for a fact because it has already happened.
: Well, yeah. Rin wants to fuck you.
: And you don’t?
: Not really.
: Not even a little?
: Okay, maybe a little. But in that quintessential teenage sort of way where I just kind of want to fuck everything.
: That never goes away.
: I think it does for most people. You’re just special.
: Thank you, Otoha.
: Special doesn’t always mean “good.” Also, why did you even knock if you were just going to come in?
: Obviously because of the changing thing. I decided that was important after the fact. Are you telling me the knock ruined my chances?
scene otohasreallyhotdude2
: What? No. I came home right after school and have been wearing these for like five hours now. If you want to catch me getting changed, you’ll need to be way earlier next time.
: Noted. I’ll be waiting.
: Hey, this whole hangout session isn’t just going to be about me and the state of undress you want me in, is it? Because that’s not what I had in mind when I asked you to come over on Christmas.
: Well, what did you have in mind? Because it sounds a lot like you’re trying to seduce me based on how much you’re bringing up getting dressed.
scene otohasreallyhotdude3
: But you’re the one who fucking-
scene otohasreallyhotdude4
: Ugh. What’s even the point? I’m sorry for trying to seduce you, Sensei. Please see past these impure impulses and have a normal conversation with me.
: Otoha, you’re really hot.
: Or don’t.
: I didn’t mean that in a creepy way.
scene otohasreallyhotdude5
: There’s no non-creepy way to say that when you’re in your thirties and I’m-
: Special too? You sure are, Otoha.
scene otohasreallyhotdude6
: Just out of curiosity, does shielding yourself from the truth make it easier to pretend you’re a good guy? Or nah.
: Nah. So anyway, are we going to make out now?
: Depends.
: If you say something like, “on whether or not I force you to,” I’m going to be sad.
: No. It depends on whether or not you gave Niki my present like I asked you to.
: Present?
: You motherfucker.
: Hey, if you’re going to call me names, please try and use ones that don’t cut so deep. That’s a sensitive topic, Otoha.
: Know what else is a sensitive topic, Sensei? My incessant pursuit of something I will never have.
: I get it. That’s like me and being happy.
: That is extremely sad.
: I know. That’s the whole point.
: Bed?
: Yes. And I know you’re just asking me to sit. But for the record, I am going to imagine you’re inviting me to do something else.
: I’m well aware. I’ve gotten used to that risk and tie it to essentially everything I ever say to you now.
scene black
Otoha and I make our way across the room, but the trip is so short that I don’t really have any time to think about anything other than her ass and oh look, we’re here now.
scene otohasreallyhotdude7
: So — why do you hate me?
: Can I be like everyone else and just blame it on hormones or something?
: That wouldn’t be a thing everyone would be blaming everything on if you actually hung out with people your own age.
: True. I guess we can just say I’m...lovably forgetful then?
: Sensei, that present was really important. You didn’t, like...lose it. Did you?
: No...I’m pretty sure it’s in my room somewhere. Which means it’s well within Niki’s reach. I just haven’t handed it over yet.
: She saw the pocket knife, though. Both of them. She was very confused.
: I really don’t care how she felt about your matching knives. I just want to be able to contact her without feeling weird as hell anymore.
: And you think your present is going to fix that? You tried to make out with her.
scene otohasreallyhotdude8
: I did not try to make out with her! It was an innocent kiss! Even if I wanted to shove her down and make her cry out my name in a fit of ecstasy.
: Yeah, what’s more innocent than sexually fantasizing about someone while forcing yourself on them?
scene otohasreallyhotdude9

: There was no force involved! It was a misunderstanding, okay?! I thought she was telling me to go for it! Which is a thing I might not have thought if I wasn’t so used to adults who want to fuck me! Thanks for that!
: Hey, yeah. How come you’re totally into the idea of boning Niki but I am an ancient dinosaur in your book?
scene otohasreallyhotdude10

: In my defense, everyone thinks she’s almost like a decade younger than she actually is. But even so, she possesses a youthful vigor that you have forgone in exchange for monk-related hallucinations and weird glasses.
: Wait, what’s weird about my glasses?
: Present. When give?
: Give soon. Why glasses?
: Why anything? World big. We small.
: I’ll give it to her the next time I see her. Which, presumably, will be tonight since she is addicted to my penis and sleeps in my bed.
: Okay, well can you maybe not put your penis in her tonight so she can actually process my gift?
: Otoha, if you were in my shoes, do you really think you’d be able to just not put your penis inside of that girl?
scene otohasreallyhotdude11
: Oh, absolutely not. I wouldn’t even let her breathe. But that’s probably because I like her more than you.
: That’s a bold claim.
: Is it though? Because you’ve got like every opportunity in the world to just live a perfect life with her. Yet you’re here trying to fuck a girl who’s still in high school.
: Can I not live a perfect life with Niki while still fucking high school girls?
scene otohasreallyhotdude12
: No! Obviously, no! How stupid are you?!
: Relax. I already know I’m a fucking moron. You don’t need to remind me.
scene otohasreallyhotdude13
: It’s just...complicated, okay?

: Niki absolutely should be the one I fully devote myself to. She’s not only perfect for me, but she’s earned it by being at my side for as long as I can remember and...helping me remember who I even am.
: There’s just...I don’t know. There’s something different about her when I compare her to everyone else that I can’t quite put my finger on.

: And I feel like if I were to devote myself to her, if I’m even capable of doing such a thing, all it would do is damn her to a life of uncertain mediocrity and...having to clean up after some hopeless douchebag.
: You’re not a hopeless douchebag, Sensei. You’re just a regular douchebag.
: Thanks, Otoha. That’s the nicest thing you’ve ever said to me.
: Look at me.
scene otohasreallyhotdude14
: Fine...
: Up here.
scene otohasreallyhotdude15
: All I want is to be free.
: Have you stopped to think that maybe you only feel that way about her because you are actually in love with her?
: Of course. But then I have to take into account the millions of horrible things I’ve done while feeling that way about Niki and it really waters down the whole point of actually being “in love.”
: If I was actually in love with her, don’t you think I’d just...not do all of those horrible things?
: Not if you’re a regular douchebag, no.
scene otohasreallyhotdude16
: But, then again, what the hell do I know about love? I’ve had a grand total of one relationship, and even that was just me being...curious about stuff and wanting to experiment.
: I think that...for me, it’s kind of like that too. Like yes, I love Niki. But-
: But you can’t help wondering if there’s someone you’d feel even better with...right?
: I...guess?
scene otohasreallyhotdude17
: So you’re just gonna fuck everyone you meet until you know for sure? Is that the plan?
: That’s been the plan so far.
: And how’s that working out for you?
: Great until I remember how many people I’m using and hurting along the way. But there are a lot of moments, where like...I feel like there’s a future with everyone.
: It’s not always a good one. But I can see it and feel it and...I can’t figure out which one would bring me the closest to some sort of finale that I’d be okay with.
: I get it. I fell in love with Maya for a few minutes recently and pictured a whole life with her that was just...gone the moment I got home.
: Yeah, she does that to people.
: The heart wants what the heart wants, I guess. Do you really think we’re bad people for not fully understanding ourselves, though?
: That is most assuredly not what makes me a bad person. You’re fine. You’re just a teenager. You haven’t had enough time to become a bad person yet.
scene otohasreallyhotdude18
: Teenagers can be bad too. Like, for all you know, I’m even more messed up than you are.
: I’m trying to picture what an evil Otoha would even look like and now I’m worried that you’re going to start stealing girls out of my harem.
: First, Rin. Next, Maya. You’re cooked.
: Yeah, just dismantle the foundation and everything else will crumble soon after.
: Oh, so Maya is the foundation? Not Niki?
scene otohasreallyhotdude19
: Wait, seriously?
: Let’s...not talk about her. Just...
: I obviously won’t tell you not to try and “steal” anyone from me. But-
scene otohasreallyhotdude20
: I’m not going to steal anyone, Sensei. I doubt I even could if I tried. I’m not exactly adored around here.
: ...but I won’t blame you or even put you in the same category as me for just wanting to experiment since now is the time of your life to actually do that.
: You don’t want to reach your thirties without knowing what you’re after. So figure everything out now while you still can.
: Just so you know, the last time someone started talking like this to me, I kissed them.
: You can kiss me if you want.
scene otohasreallyhotdude21
: I know. I’m just not sure if I even want to risk you being the person I wind up wanting the most. Being into older people has been nothing but a headache so far.
: Well, I’m definitely not going to recommend following in my footsteps and corrupting the younger demographic when doing that for you would literally involve robbing cradles.
: I mean, they wouldn’t have to be that much younger. But going down even a few grades when you’re my age will make people talk.
: Well, Otoha, that’s because your bodies are going through changes right now and-
: If I do kiss you, will you shut the fuck up about whatever you’re about to say?
: Yes, but it will probably be out of shock since I didn’t think you’d graduated past simply masturbating in front of me yet.
scene otohasreallyhotdude22
: I told you to stop bringing that up.
: Wait...you’re not actually going to kiss me, are you?
: You’re not gonna, like...grab my ass if I do, are you?
: Uhh...nooooo?
: That’s the least convincing “noooooo” I’ve ever heard.
: Sorry. I’m just getting a million different signals right now and I’m not sure how many of them are only there to fuck with me.
: You said it’s time for me to experiment, right? I’ve never kissed a boy. You’ve never kissed me. We’re both lonely. All signs say we should do this.
: I...mean...
scene otohasreallyhotdude23
: ...is what I would have said if you’d given my present to Niki and provided me any amount of closure on that chapter in my life.
: I’ve never been more regretful to be forgetful than I am right now.
: You’re lucky you don’t have that pocketknife on you or I’d use it to chop your balls off.
: I’ve never been more thankful to be forgetful than I am right now.
: The funniest part, though? I’m actually serious.
: You...actually would have tried? But just a minute ago, you were all like “I’m Otoha. I don’t even want to want you.”
: Yeah. I’m like a lot of things. But I do get to blame it on hormones because, unlike you, I-
scene otohasreallyhotdude24
scene otohasreallyhotdude25
: N-Nodoka! Heeeeey!
: This...was not on my bingo card so early.
: It’s not what it looks like!
: Yeah. Otoha was just telling me that she’ll only fuck me after I close the door on her chances of fucking my girlfriend.
: That- no! There is no “fucking!”
: Ass grabbing, then. Sorry.
: None of that either! You don’t-
scene otohasreallyhotdude26
: KYAH!
: Your boob just touched me. Look at you, trying to seduce me when you could just have me whenever you want.
: I got scared, okay?! How was I supposed to know that Nodoka’s fucking Starbucks cup would sound like a broken window after being dropped?! There’s no way that was the correct sound effect!
: Shut up. Wait. I have to...
: Something is...
scene otohasreallyhotdude27
: Something is...coming!
: Is Nodoka really about to have an orgasm in the middle of the doorway?
: No, I think-
scene otohasreallyhotdude28
: INSPIRATION!
: Yeah. I think it’s that.
: Once more, from the top! Spare no detail! I need to see everything about how the two of you made it to this point!
: Well...
scene black
: It all started when I walked in on Otoha changing...
: Don’t go changing the story right from the start!
